description: Check baseline eligibility and captured context, then run a fixed candidate budget using the original predicate. Requires explicit current command/cwd. Reports target_observed, target_not_observed, inconclusive or interrupted; zero matches with unrelated errors is inconclusive, never proof of a fix.

allowChanges.description: Explicitly declare intended context interventions and their reasons. Missing evidence cannot be made comparable by allowing a change.

args.description: Explicit current literal executable arguments; absent selects shell mode, never inherits saved args. Changes require a command allowance.

baseline.description: Full run ID, unique UUID prefix (at least 8 characters), latest/last, directory or run.json. Shorthands search only cwd/.failtrace/runs, including incomplete runs. Save the returned full ID/path and reuse it across calls; latest may select a different run later. Nested investigation runs require explicit paths.

command.description: Explicit current command, at most 64 KiB UTF-8, to authorize local execution; the saved command is never executed implicitly.

cwd.description: Required current working directory; relative paths resolve from the server directory.

healthyExitCodes.description: Normal exit codes accepted for nonmatching trials; default [0].

maxOutputBytes.description: Inherits baseline. Changing it requires an outputLimits allowance.

maxTotalOutputBytes.description: Inherits baseline. Changing it requires an outputLimits allowance.

repeat.description: Full candidate trial budget, at most 100000; defaults to the baseline requested count. No classification early stopping.

name: failtrace_verify
title: Verify a candidate against baseline evidence
